notes.1.129: Line 130: {ḥḥ} is deleted by the editor in favour of ḥtm 'destroy'. Line 131: ḥrw.ṱ, 'far away', may mean 'on guard'. Line 134: j-ḏbw is obscure; taken as 'repaying'. Lines 135 and 137: dmꜣ n pḥ,wj-kꜣ,t, 'binding of the end of the work', is uncertain. Line 138: rdḥw is unexplained.

nodes.text: Now, as for the wax which they work: it is made into rebels, to cut off his name, so as not to let his ba come forth from the place of execution.
As for the wax: they make knots in it, to destroy his name.
You must not be slack concerning it, while you keep very, very far away.
It is the great protection of Wennefer, which makes protection for the king in his palace.
And they are brought to put them under the flame of Sekhmet, to destroy the rebels.
Now, as for the two doors of the West: he stands at them for Osiris, repaying(?) the matter that happened under him in the beginning.
The binding of the end of the work: first month of Akhet, [day] 20, the day of receiving the books and dispatching the books.
Life and death come forth from it.
The binding of the end of the work is done on it.
A secret book, which overturns magic, ties knots, makes the knots fast, and ... (rdḥw) the whole circuit.
Life is in it, death is in it.
You shall not carry it out.
As for one who carries it out, he will die a sudden death, by slaughter at once.
